new_insert_email_body.title: London Hotel Booking - Thames View Priority
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

The London trip is confirmed for May 28–30, 2024. Could you review London hotels, filter for properties where guest reviews explicitly mention views of the River Thames, and reserve the best one for those dates? This needs to be locked in before we move ahead with other travel arrangements — the Paris car rental depends on it.

Thanks,
Mark
